description: This file provides the Chinese (Hong Kong) localization for the jQuery Timepicker Addon, setting regional labels and default options for the timepicker widget.

methods.name: $.timepicker.regional['zh-HK']
methods.description: Defines the regional settings for Chinese (Hong Kong) including labels for time selection.

methods.name: $.timepicker.setDefaults
methods.description: Sets the default configuration for the timepicker widget globally.
